decisions.reason: As a certified HVAC plate heat exchanger, it is close to the firm's thermal-engineering knowledge base and certification suggests enough committed capability that management would usually continue learning rather than exit quickly.

The reported strong quality reputation and major market share in water cooling systems give clear positive feedback in a domain that fits the firm's existing cooling expertise, making withdrawal unlikely.
A marine cooling unit is technologically related to the firm's core heat-exchange competences, and having its own page suggests sufficient strategic importance to keep developing it.

Although the compact oil cooler is only briefly mentioned and may be less established, it still builds on the firm's existing know-how in industrial cooling equipment, so management would more likely refine than drop it.
Finned tubes for air coolers are very close to the firm's component-level knowledge base, and a dedicated product page indicates absorptive capacity and intent to build this line further.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes directly leverage the firm's established heat-transfer capabilities, so the firm is likely to retain them and apply ongoing technical learning rather than remove them.
